questions.question: Is the main subject clearly a sleek glowing AI assistant orb hovering over a tidy modern desk, connected by luminous threads to a fanned-out deck of translucent holographic tool cards?

Is the subject depicted cards labeled create_message, create_room, create_team, create_webhook fan out like a magician's card trick toward a large holographic team-messaging workspace panel with green checkmarks?
Does the overall style read as 'futuristic product-launch CGI, iridescent blue and teal gradients, particle light trails, high-end motion graphics, 16:9 cinematic still'?
